title: MediCare frontend redesign — scope
question: This redesign replaces the visual world of the entire frontend (landing, auth, booking wizard, patient dashboards, doctor schedule, admin). How far does the new world run in this pass?

options.label: Whole frontend, patient-first
options.body: The new world commits everywhere: public landing, login/register, booking wizard, patient dashboard, appointments, payments, reviews, profile, doctor schedule surfaces, and the admin tables. Admin inherits the world at quieter density — rebuilt in the same vocabulary, never stock.

options.label: Patient-facing surfaces first
options.body: The new world lands on everything a patient sees: landing, auth, booking wizard, dashboard, appointments, payments, reviews, profile. The admin section stays on the incumbent system for a later pass.

options.label: Landing + booking wizard only
options.body: The public face and the decision point get the full new world now; authenticated dashboards and admin keep the incumbent look for a later pass.
